name: email-visit-tracker-root
description: Email-Based Website Visit Tracking & Browser Automation Platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r automation/requirements.txt && python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.test:playwright: python automation/playwright_runner.py --url http://localhost:5000/api/demo/page --email test.verification@synthetictest.internal --session-id SES-CLI-TEST --scroll-duration 10 --headless true
